icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: Mapped ICD at matched rank is E10.10 (Type 1 diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis without coma); billed primary is O24.03 (Pre-existing type 1 diabetes mellitus, in the puerperium). Both code the same principal condition — pre-existing type 1 diabetes mellitus — with the obstetric chapter code sequenced first only because of the puerperal encounter, and O24.03 conventionally requires an additional E10.- code (here E10.10) to specify the ketoacidosis. A coder would accept these as clinically equivalent for the same principal condition, though the exact codes differ by chapter/obstetric sequencing rules.
